assertions.subject: onboard-hmi/appsettings.json agvId
assertions.note: Deployment gap: shipped onboard identity is a sample value, not the site vehicle.

assertions.expected: 304e6ad9952a41d5c0d50c0c4e79bab5c8804bd6 (the commit this RC was built from)
assertions.note: Owned by the read-only onboard repository; carried forward from ticket 11 and ticket 25.

assertions.control: same probe against 172.19.206.222:8899 returned True (must be False)

assertions.note: SIMULATED IO. This is not evidence about real IO modules, wiring, locks or light curtains.

assertions.subject: ControlServer.Host.exe started straight from the RC tree
shipped OnboardHmi binary establishes a session with the shipped ControlServer
assertions.expected: onboard log contains '上层会话已建立'
assertions.control: same detector, same directory, before the onboard started returned '<none>' (must be none)
assertions.note: Runs only after wireToGate.enabled and agvId are corrected in a copy; see CFG-ONBOARD-ENABLED.

assertions.subject: GET /health/ready once the onboard session exists
assertions.control: the same endpoint before the onboard connected returned 503, so a 200 here is the session, not a permissive gate
assertions.note: The readiness gate requires an onboard session reporting Readiness=Ready.

assertions.subject: onboard readiness reported on a clean install with a fresh journal
assertions.expected: Ready, if a clean deployment is immediately operable
assertions.control: parsed out of the SESSION-ESTABLISHED line, which its own control shows is absent before the onboard starts
assertions.note: Drives DEPLOY-HEALTH: the readiness gate admits only Ready.

assertions.subject: ControlServer MesIngest adapter against the existing MesIngest
assertions.expected: JourneyBacklog holds demands read from MesIngest
assertions.control: AcceptedDemands=0 and JourneyRuntimes=0 on the same database, so a non-zero backlog is a real read and not every table being populated

assertions.subject: the onboard session reached the ControlServer store
assertions.control: ProtocolOutbox and StationOperations stayed empty in the same run, so this is not a blanket write

assertions.subject: ControlServer RIoT adapter exercised against the real RIoT
assertions.expected: a durable row derived from a RIoT read
assertions.actual: no RIoT-derived row; only NET-RIOT reachability stands
assertions.note: The read path (ReadVehicleAsync / ReadMapStationsAsync / ReadVehicleSafetyAsync) persists nothing, and is only reached once a demand is accepted, which SESSION-READINESS blocks.

assertions.subject: no RIoT order created during qualification
assertions.control: the same table is what a real create writes; ticket 11 and the G3 runs show it non-empty when the gate is open

assertions.subject: screen, touch and barcode scanner on the target vehicle terminal
assertions.note: External input missing: this run is on a development workstation, not the vehicle terminal.

assertions.subject: real eight-slot IO module, wiring, locks and light curtains
